d:
The Maestro features ONCE AGAIN on KBC!
After 8 Years, Niladri Kumaar visits KBC AGAIN and stuns everyone with his incredible Live Performance. If you've watched the first one, Now watch the Second!
Sitar Zitar Icon Niladri Kumaar delivers Music that leaves Amitabh Bachchan Aamir Khan and all the fans in a frenzy! Mr Bachchan's favourite tune too is played here. Ending with the magical rendition of Niladri Kumaar's most loved Bhairavi and the Iconic Don played on Zitar.
